entities.summary: Lucas Joshua Van Berkel is a Canadian male volleyball player from Edmonton, Alberta. He is part of the Canada men's national volleyball team. On club level, he plays for United Volleys Rhein-Main. In June 2021, Van Berkel was named to Canada's 2020 Olympic team.
